title: F126.3.4 start, follow and stop a run: a live run started and stopped
caption: A person opens the ask on the card of an eval of six conversations, starts a live run, follows it on its page, and stops it. The page asks the run's address how it goes. A stop cancels the conversation in play, and the run is kept as stopped with what it had graded.

steps.text: the ask opens in the card: 3 repeats, about $0.09, from the row's last live run
202, Location: the run's address (or 409, a run is going)
the browser goes to the run's page
saved after each conversation, with both costs
GET the run, every 3 seconds while it is running
the run so far: 2 of 6 graded
the conversation in play is cancelled, and its session is closed
saved as stopped, with the end time and the reason
stopped: the page shows its box and reads no more
